svg.aria-label: Two phones and Supabase. Act 1: phone A hard-deletes the mirror cabinet from the bathroom shopping list, the row disappears from Postgres, phone B comes back online, asks what changed since its last sync, gets nothing back and keeps showing the cabinet forever. Act 2: phone A deletes it as a tombstone, the row stays in Postgres with deleted: true, phone B receives it and removes the cabinet.
svg.title: Deleting offline: hard delete vs tombstone

g.text: still shows the cabinet. buys it.
DELETE FROM items: the row is gone
